what: What did each Lunenburg town employee earn in 1987?
why: `report-gross-wages` holds per-employee earnings from the 1995-2010 reports (as printed) and FY2011-FY2025. The 1987 annual town report prints no wage list: its text (76 pages, every page) was searched for wage, gross, payroll, salary, compensation and employees and returned only the balance sheet's `ACCRUED WAGES PAYABLE` (p38), a Treasurer paragraph saying the new account numbering will let the Town `determine how much the town is spending on utilities or wages` (text line 1938), the appropriation lines for officers' salaries (pp31-35, p51) and the Article 5 vote to replace the Classification and Salary Schedule (p51) -- no list by employee (sources/data/report-tables/1987/). — closes: the Town's calendar-1987 payroll register (W-2 totals by employee) from the Treasurer's office.

what: What were the town's non-union salary grades and step rates in fiscal 1988?
why: `salary-schedule` and `report-classification-plan` read Schedule A from the 2010 report and FY2011 onward. The 1987 annual town report records the vote but not the schedule: an article of the May 9, 1987 Annual Town Meeting deletes `the Classification and Salary Schedule voted on April 12, 1986` and substitutes the one `proposed by` the Personnel Committee (text line 5727; the schedule itself is not printed). Searched for salary schedule, classification, step and grade (sources/data/report-tables/1987/). — closes: the Finance Committee's report to the May 9, 1987 Annual Town Meeting, which printed the Classification & Salary Schedule.

what: What did each special revenue fund take in, spend and carry forward in fiscal 1987?
why: `special-revenue-funds` holds forward, receipts, disbursements and balance by fund from the 1992-2010 reports. The 1987 annual town report prints no special revenue schedule: the only special revenue figures are the balance sheet's SPECIAL REVENUE column, $327,269 of cash and $364,814 of assets (p38), and grant-funded items inside the general fund appropriations schedule (`rct`-tagged lines, pp33-35). The text was searched for special revenue, revolving, grant and gift and returned department prose (text lines 851, 1061-1065, 1194) and the trust funds (pp42-44) (sources/data/report-tables/1987/). — closes: the Town Accountant's fiscal 1987 special revenue fund ledger.

what: What was appropriated, spent and carried forward on each capital project fund in fiscal 1987?
why: `report-capital-projects` holds a capital project fund schedule from the 1999-2010 reports. The 1987 annual town report prints none: its balance sheet has a CAPITAL PROJECTS column of $234,959 of assets and $199,431 of fund equity (p38), but no schedule beneath it. Capital articles appear INSIDE the general fund appropriations schedule (e.g. `Purchase Dump Truck` $16,800 and `Highway Garage Roof` $15,000, p34, funded by transfers from the stabilization fund, p44). The text was searched for capital project and capital fund and returned nothing (sources/data/report-tables/1987/). — closes: the Town Accountant's fiscal 1987 capital projects fund ledger.

what: What did each item of Lunenburg's fiscal 1988 capital plan cost?
why: `capital-plans` holds item-by-item costs from 1999-2010. The 1987 annual town report prints no capital plan: `Capital Prioritization` appears as a $28,151.86 appropriation line (p31) and as an investment account (p9), and the Finance Committee prose discusses financing capital through debt and the stabilization fund (text lines 1941-1946) without a list. Searched for capital plan and capital prioritization (sources/data/report-tables/1987/). — closes: the Capital Prioritization study the Town paid for, or the Finance Committee's fiscal 1988 report listing capital articles.

what: What was Lunenburg's assessed valuation by property class, its levy, overlay and new growth for fiscal 1987?
why: `report-valuation` holds valuation and levy by property class from 1995-2010. The 1987 annual town report prints the total real estate and personal property valuation as a line in ABOUT THE TOWN (p3) and the tax levy by year since Proposition 2 1/2 (p27, landed here as `report-tax-levy-history`), but no breakdown by class, no overlay and no new growth. Searched for valuation, levy, overlay, new growth and tax rate (sources/data/report-tables/1987/). — closes: the Board of Assessors' fiscal 1987 tax rate recapitulation (the Tax Rate Recap filed with the Department of Revenue).

what: How many Lunenburg children were placed out of district in 1987?
why: `placement-counts` holds this from the Special Services report in the FY2013-FY2025 annual town reports. The 1987 annual town report mentions special education only as programs inside the schools (a `Special Needs Language Class` and two self-contained classes, text lines 7088-7267) and prints no count of out-of-district placements. Searched for special education, special needs, placement, tuition and 766 (sources/data/report-tables/1987/). — closes: the School Department's October 1987 count of placements by type, or the Department of Education's fiscal 1987 end-of-year report.
